plain: A paid office that requires little or no work

webster.text: An office which has revenue without employment; in church affairs, a benefice without cure of souls.

example.quote: No sinecure can be bestowed on any judge but by the concurrence of the whole legislature and the President ; and I do not think this an event that will probably happen.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, December 11, 1787 and the following sittings (Elliot prints no later date headings) (2d ed. 1836)
